name: Jiangsu Huachen Transformer Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Huachen Transformer Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of power transmission and distribution and control equipment in China and internationally. The company offers oil-immersed distribution transformer, dry type distribution transformer, oil-immersed transformers, and transformer substation; and new energy box-type transformers, prefabricated substations, combined substations, and electrical complete sets of equipment. Its products are used in base mall, colleges, community, grid company, hydropower project, other projects, public construction, and traffic project applications.
